notes.title: Major Demo Update
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]After a period of quiet, a fairly significant update for the Demo is here! Let's dive into the details![/p][p][/p][h3]1. Major New Feature: "Sickness Rate" Mechanism[/h3][list][*][p]A new stat to watch: Sickness Rate. When it hits 100%, your character becomes Sick. While Sick, you cannot eat anything until you naturally recover after some time. This makes you highly susceptible to starvation, so be very careful to avoid getting sick![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]How Sickness Rate Increases:It rises slowly when you are away from the Light Towers (e.g., while exploring the wilderness), as the gloom feels oppressive. It increases rapidly if you are in complete darkness.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]How to Reduce Sickness Rate:Herbs now have a chance to spawn in well-lit areas. Consuming them reduces your Sickness Rate. [b]Important: You cannot eat anything, including Herbs, while Sick![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700530/cd438760fd174f039b4822c2a6194b3b232addb3.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]2. Light Towers: No Longer a Game Over Condition[/h3][list][*][p]Previously, the game would end if all Light Towers in a scene went out. Now, the only game over condition is your Hunger reaching zero.[/p][/*][*][p]This change reduces the learning curve – just focus on keeping your Hunger above zero.[/p][/*][*][p]Hehe, but don't get complacent! Light Towers are still crucial. Their mysterious light lowers your Sickness Rate. Staying near a Tower prevents your Sickness Rate from increasing. Without them, getting sick becomes super easy![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]3. Multiple Art Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Ahem, we admit the previous art was quite rudimentary. While we aim for a minimalist style, minimalism shouldn't mean 粗糙 (rough). Many areas have been redesigned and redrawn for a more polished and visually pleasing look.[/p][/*][*][p]The Hunger UI has been changed from a circle to a square.[/p][/*][*][p]The Unit Information Panel has received a visual upgrade.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700530/ad913c98f961fbcc44d49d2cd47a3abf86bf57e4.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]4. Other Changes[/h3][list][*][p]The "Shrill Voice" dialogue sound effect has been changed.[/p][/*][*][p]The stack limit for all items has been increased to 999.[/p][/*][*][p]Added sound effects for eating.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the volume of the BGM.[/p][/*][*][p]The trading interface with the "Hoarse Voice" now displays your remaining currency, so you no longer need to check your backpack.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]5. Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Save System Improvements: The save system is more robust. More data is correctly preserved between game sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Stability: Enhanced overall stability, reducing crashes caused by critical bugs.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Weekly Update & Future Plans
notes.content: [p]First, thank you to all players who have tried the Demo, especially those who provided feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Over the past 7 days, based on your feedbacks, I've made a total of 12 updates, including the following:[/p][p][/p][h3]Quality Updates:[/h3][p]*Adjusted the attack interval for each chapter. Attack intervals can now be set in seconds.[/p][p]*Adjusted the position of mouse tooltips in unit content to the left side of the cursor.[/p][p]*Now, when most tooltips show required materials, they will also display the total remaining quantity of that material in your inventory.[/p][p]*Bombs now have sound effects when exploding.[/p][p]*Added missing translations.[/p][p]*Added two lines about the Magic Gate in the initial dialogue of Chapter 1.[/p][p]*Added rough monitoring of the Light God's attack timing.[/p][p]*Moved the spawn location of the Magic Gate in Chapter 1 closer.[/p][p]*Added several new dialogue segments.[/p][p]*Added a full-screen warning when hunger is too low – very cool![/p][p]*The death panel now displays different text based on the cause of death.[/p][p]*Modified the art for dark tiles; they are now transparent and less cluttered.[/p][p]*Increased the amount of Light Source required to destroy the Dark Gate in Chapter 2.[/p][p]*A small number of treasure chests now spawn during gameplay.[/p][p]*Added a new unit: Torch Warehouse. Use it to select the torch for expeditions. Currently features Small Torch and Large Torch, each with distinct characteristics.[/p][p]*Added a torch-holding icon to the player's expedition representation.[/p][p]*Modified the visual representation of the Corruption circle at the top of the screen when using dark abilities.[/p][p]*Reduced the volume of background music (BGM).[/p][p]*Unit trait tags now have a shader effect, making them more visible to players.[/p][p]*Enlarged the UI for craftable items in the Workbench and Simple Stove crafting content for easier interaction.[/p][p]*Made the flashing UI in the top-right corner for low Lighthouse fuel larger and more noticeable.[/p][p]*Removed the close button from the unit panel; now simply click on an empty tile to close it.[/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3][p]*Fixed a bug where vines did not spawn during gameplay.[/p][p]*Fixed a bug where tiles could not be flipped.[/p][p]*Fixed an error that occurred when switching from the game scene to the main menu scene. This error caused various anomalies in new games.[/p][p]*Other minor bugs.[/p][p][/p][h3]Recent Update Plans:[/h3][p]*The game will soon receive a "Combat System" update. During wilderness exploration, you will encounter wild beasts and engage in combat. The goal of this system is to increase the fun of wilderness exploration. When first introduced, the combat mechanics will be relatively simple and will be gradually refined in subsequent updates.[/p]
